title: Funding Proposal for a DAO focused on sports editorial media
body:
** Date of proposal**
1. January 17th, 2022


- **Author/s of proposal**
1. Juan Castro // @juanlinebreaker on commonwealth/Discord
2. [juan@breakingthelines.com](mailto:juan@breakingthelines.com)


- **Proposal summary**


In Breaking The Lines we've been operating since 2016 as a decentralized non-automated organization, giving a solid platform to upcoming writers for sharing their knowledge and opinion related to football (soccer). 

BTL is a media hub disrupting global sports journalism with more than 200 collaborators all over the globe. Everyone in BTL has an incredible sense of passion for creating data-driven content while avoiding the distribution of material full of assumptions or click-bait content to our avid fanbase on Twitter (53k followers), generating more than 1.6M website visits since Jan 2020. 

This year we are looking to work with Edgeware, supporting BTL with funding to develop a DAO platform focused on creating one of the biggest and most reliable sports newsrooms in the Web3. 

- **Member/Partner support* (note this will be a subject of a separate post)**

_I’ve introduced BTL and its project on a Community Call and Edgeware’s Discord server_
- **Are they providing the 5% bonding fees required to propose?**


- **Are they also staking (risking) reputation/funds to assure milestones are met?**

_BTL could risk reputation with its collaborators and with BTL’s community as well_
- **What support are they delivering the proposal?**
- _Software Developing Support (x 3) _
- _Editorial Support x 2_
- _Graphic Support x 1_
- _Operational Support  x 2_
- **Is this support part of the funding request?**

_Yes [Editorial & Operations support]_
- **What is their relationship to the project and/or team?**

_Co-Founder, Operations & BD Manager for BTL. _
